title: 2.5.11 Fix the Silent Catch
description: An empty catch block is hiding a failure. Add a report so the next person can see it. Auto-graded.
sourceRef: designed: practice for 2.5.2 Context Pause (the empty catch block)

steps.title: Find the silent catch
steps.instructions: The starter's catch block is empty. Nothing tells you the order total failed to calculate.

steps.title: Report it
steps.instructions: Add a console.log inside the catch block that says what happened, for example "Could not calculate the total."

aiCheck.rubricTitle: What the AI read in your code
aiCheck.prompt: The student wrote JavaScript for the lab "2.5.11 Fix the Silent Catch". The task they were given: The starter's catch block is empty. Nothing tells you the order total failed to calculate. You cannot run their code: read it and judge what it WOULD do. Judge each criterion by whether the idea is achieved, however the student wrote it. Different variable and function names, template strings, arrow functions, semicolons, spacing, quotes and order are all fine. Do not require any particular structure unless the criterion names one. Mark a criterion missing only when the idea is absent or the code does the opposite. Code inside a comment never runs. Write each note for THIS student's own code: in a not-met note, name the exact line or name in their code that causes the problem (quote at most a few words of it), say in plain words what it does now versus what the criterion needs, and give one concrete next thing to try, but do NOT write the corrected code. In a met note, say in one short phrase what in their code satisfied it. Do not use generic praise.
